name: Rearmament resets the cooldown of the Traps (#1086)
contract: Rearmament 805738 reads 'resetting the cooldown of all Traps and Decimate, and causing your Traps to not incur a cooldown for the duration' (Spell.dbc 2026-09-17). Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN on Decimate 804194 (native, EffectAscensionResetCooldown), effect 2 a -101% SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN on the Trap class mask (native). Effect 1 is effect id 197 with class mask (0, 0, 0x840000), BasePoints -100000: in the core Spell::EffectNULL handles 197 ('unknown Ascension effect') and no module handled it, so the Traps kept their cooldowns. What effect 197 means is not documented in the source; that it reduces the cooldowns of the spells matching its class mask is inferred from the many other spells that carry it with a class mask and a negative millisecond amount and are named or worded as cooldown reductions. This scenario therefore rests on Rearmament's own text: after it is cast, both the Trap (Shadow Trap 680238, 60 s cooldown, mask word2 0x840000) and Decimate (120 s) report no cooldown. Only Rearmament's own cast is covered; the no-cooldown-for-the-duration clause is native and not asserted.

steps.label: Shadow Trap is on its 60 s cooldown
Decimate is on its 120 s cooldown
